items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: O'Niel Spencer -- who fed them double time -- the thing with the fast wrists, and he and Charlie Shaver, they almost blew Charlie Barnet 's 16 pieces

ctx.x: O'Niel Spencer -- who fed them double time -- the thing with the fast wrists, and he and Charlie Shaver, they almost blew Charlie Barnet 's 16 pieces -- we had four trombones, and four or five trumpets then, and you should have heard them out swing us at certain points.
